newsitem.title: ITALY: Mafioso on run sets cat as condition for return.
newsitem.headline: Mafioso on run sets cat as condition for return.

text.p: A suspected Mafioso sentenced to eight years in jail and on the run for three has offered to turn himself in -- as long as his cat can come too.

Claudio Camastra, a lawyer for 36-year-old suspected Mob member Mario Milano, told news agency ANSA on Monday that police officials from Sicily were already in contact with his client to discuss his return from hiding in Canada.

Camastra said that apart from not wanting to be separated from his persian cat Minu, Milano also wanted to be jailed in the western Sicilian port of Agrigento and to be able to talk to his family as soon as he returned home. He had no more details.
